topup_order_id.meaning: Primary id of the top-up or bill-pay order.

sender_account_id.meaning: Personal Sender Account the order is placed under (foreign key -> sender_accounts).

variant_name.meaning: Product ordered, as the official product name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the order (topup charter lifecycle).

destination_number.meaning: Phone, meter or biller account number currently on the order, exactly as the customer gave it.

destination_holder_name.meaning: Name on the destination account or the student's name; empty when not required.

student_reference.meaning: Student reference for school fees; empty otherwise.

order_reference.meaning: Order reference on the customer's receipt (e.g. PT-260917-55102); the customer quotes it.

face_value_local.format: payout currency, 2 decimal places (whole units for VND)

principal_usd.meaning: USD value of the order, excluding fees.

service_fee_usd.meaning: Service fee charged on the order.

card_fee_usd.meaning: Credit-card funding fee charged; 0.00 when none.

fx_rate.format: payout-currency units per 1 USD, 4 decimal places
fx_rate.meaning: Rate used to convert the order value.

ordered_at.format: ISO 8601 timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS on Paloma's operations clock (US Central Time), exactly as returned by ctx.now()

submitted_at.format: ISO 8601 timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS on Paloma's operations clock (US Central Time), exactly as returned by ctx.now()
submitted_at.meaning: Moment the latest attempt was sent; empty before submission.

delivered_at.format: ISO 8601 timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS on Paloma's operations clock (US Central Time), exactly as returned by ctx.now()
delivered_at.meaning: Moment of delivery confirmation; empty until delivered.

delivery_token.meaning: Electricity token code; empty for other products and before delivery.

failed_at.format: ISO 8601 timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS on Paloma's operations clock (US Central Time), exactly as returned by ctx.now()
failed_at.meaning: Moment the latest failure was confirmed; empty when none.

cancelled_at.format: ISO 8601 timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS on Paloma's operations clock (US Central Time), exactly as returned by ctx.now()
cancelled_at.meaning: Moment of cancellation; empty unless cancelled.

closed_date.meaning: Date the order reached delivered or refunded; empty while open.

principal_held_usd.meaning: Order value Paloma holds; always the signed sum of the order_funds entries.

fees_held_usd.meaning: Fees Paloma holds; always fee charges minus fee refunds.

topup_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of the ledger entry.

topup_order_id.meaning: Order the entry belongs to (foreign key -> topup_orders).

event_type.meaning: Event family, verbatim from the topup charter.

amount_usd.meaning: Amount moved, always positive; the direction comes from the event family.

fee_refund_reason.meaning: Why a fee is refunded; none otherwise.

attempt.meaning: Attempt an entry concerns; 0 when not tied to an attempt.

failure_reason.meaning: Why an attempt was rejected; none otherwise.

refund_basis.meaning: Why the order value is refunded; none otherwise.

related_entry_id.meaning: topup_entry_id of the fee charge a fee refund points back to; empty otherwise.

topup_case_id.meaning: Primary id of the case row.

topup_order_id.meaning: Order the case concerns (foreign key -> topup_orders).

event_type.meaning: Event family, verbatim from the topup charter.

corrected_destination.meaning: Corrected destination number, exactly as the customer gave it; empty otherwise.

correction_seq.meaning: Number of the correction on the order; 0 otherwise.

resend_seq.meaning: Number of the token re-send; 0 otherwise.

case_type.meaning: What a dispute claims; none otherwise.

related_case_id.meaning: topup_case_id of the dispute a decision answers; empty otherwise.

case_outcome.meaning: open on disputes; the finding on decisions; not_applicable otherwise.

resolution_due_date.meaning: Last day for Paloma's decision on a dispute; empty otherwise.

verification_id.meaning: Primary id of the identity-verification record (one per customer).

verified.meaning: Whether identity verification passed; monotonically non-decreasing.

verified_at.format: ISO 8601 timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS on Paloma's operations clock (US Central Time), exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: Moment of the most recent verification attempt.

handoff_id.meaning: Primary id of the human-handoff record.

reason.meaning: Reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values.

created_at.format: ISO 8601 timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS on Paloma's operations clock (US Central Time), exactly as returned by ctx.now()
